rationale: C104 flagged zero fair_value rows. The raw SOI includes revolver rows whose fair value column is a dash, including table 16 row 29 for ATL II MRO Holdings Inc. with principal dash, cost (55), fair value dash, and net-assets percentage dash. Other revolver rows show the same source pattern. Normalizing the source dash to 0.0 is correct for fair_value; the rule warning is overbroad for legitimate zero/dash fair-value revolver rows.
